items.title: Huning Highland Historic Overlay Zone and EDo Urban Conservation Overlay Zone Map
items.description: Maps the January 2017 parcel-level boundaries of the Huning Highland Historic Overlay Zone and EDo Urban Conservation Overlay Zone, identifying their relationship to Central Avenue, the rail corridor, and surrounding streets.
items.provenance_status: official City Planning Urban Design and Development PDF, visually inspected and preserved without modification
processing_notes: Original one-page City PDF preserved without modification after exact size and SHA-256 capture.
Text extraction is parcel-label-heavy, so the map boundary, title, date, scale, and historic-zone approval note were visually reviewed.
